record.title: Build identity-bound FRAM acquisition wrapper and disposable controls
record.intent: Preserve two exact-completion device reads with explicit adapter identity and failure artifacts.
requirements: Implement a bounded ARM64 wrapper using the reviewed combined selector/read core, with no stored-data writes or forced slave selection; preserve return values and partial buffers.
Require explicit character-device path and identity, fixed address0x50 and8192-byte geometry; preserve two images separately and stop on failure or disagreement.
Prove actual wrapper control flow, syscalls, identity checks and failure artifacts with host/disposable controls before physical execution; record concurrency limits.
acceptance: The reviewed wrapper is ready for a separately recorded physical acquisition.
